name: Earth Elemental

actions.name: Slam
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Earth Tremor
actions.effect: All creatures within 6m touching the ground must pass PHYS save or take damage and fall prone. Difficult terrain is created in the area.

actions.name: Boulder Hurl
actions.effect: Ranged attack at medium range. Target must pass PHYS save or be pushed 3m back.

reactions.name: Stone Shield
reactions.effect: Raises a wall of stone to block an attack. Adds +5 to physical defense against one attack.

reactions.name: Ground Grip
reactions.effect: When an adjacent creature tries to move away, the ground grabs their feet. Target must pass PHYS save or be unable to move this turn.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.desc: Can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: Deals double damage to objects and structures.

lore: Earth Elementals are hulking masses of stone and soil given form. They are the most resilient of elementals, shrugging off blows that would shatter lesser creatures. When they walk, the ground itself trembles.
